runners_data.name: All Night Revival

runners_data.name: The First Turn

runners_data.name: De Jour En Jour

runners_data.name: Loyal Praetorian
runners_data.note: Hold-up style struggling since December second place, pulled up last time suggests current form concerns
runners_data.comment: Rated 102, hasn't built on Clonmel second, pulled up in handicap latest, needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't really fired since a Clonmel maiden hurdle second in December; pulled up on handicap debut at Cork on latest; rated 102 and needs more back in maiden company.

runners_data.name: Miss Donna
runners_data.note: Hold-up style returning from 183-day layoff, mid-80s RPRs insufficient for this level of competition
runners_data.comment: Similar level of form in a bumper and two maiden hurdles, much more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Has run to similar RPRs in the mid-80s in a bumper and two maiden hurdles; much more needed.

races.paceDynamic: The First Turn is the only confirmed front runner in this 10-horse field, likely to set an uncontested lead from The First Turn's preferred prominent position, with Dunleer Crystal and Poet's Duke tracking in second and third. The sustainable pace will allow hold-up horses like Ifallgoeswell, All Night Revival, De Jour En Jour and Loyal Praetorian to get into contention turning for home. With no pace pressure early and the 2m4f trip providing ample time for closers to mount their challenge, this race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If The First Turn sets uncontested fractions and the pace quickens only from the final hurdle
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop allows stamina types to close strongly while early leaders tire in the final furlong. Hold-up runners benefit from the even pace distribution and can time their challenges perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If The First Turn maintains tactical speed and the chasing pack fails to organize an effective pursuit
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to conserve energy for a determined finish while prominent racers struggle to close the gap. The uncontested lead becomes a winning advantage.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Dunleer Crystal and Poet's Duke apply early pressure to The First Turn
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field but suits horses positioned just behind the speed who can inherit the lead turning for home. Elliott's tactical nous with Dunleer Crystal could prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If The First Turn stops quickly and the prominent group also fades
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish between the backmarkers who have been patiently ridden throughout. The slowest early pace favours those with the most finishing kick.

watchPoints.text: The First Turn could get an uncontested lead and prove hard to peg back if none of the prominent runners apply early pressure
Ifallgoeswell ran just 5 days ago at Cork and quick turnaround could impact stamina reserves in the closing stages
Great Entirely pulled up on sole previous start and represents complete unknown quantity making market moves significant
Loyal Praetorian was pulled up last time and current fitness levels remain questionable after recent disappointments
Jack Kennedy's booking of Dunleer Crystal for Gordon Elliott suggests stable confidence despite 62-day absence

races.paceDynamic: Green Angel is the confirmed front runner and will likely dictate from the start, with no obvious pace pressure from this field of predominantly hold-up horses. With 17 runners mostly rated to sit off the pace, Green Angel can bowl along at a comfortable gallop without early pressure, potentially setting up a tactical finish. The lack of prominent racers means the pace could become pedestrian in the middle stages before quickening late. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems behind, with hold-up horses facing a significant disadvantage in such a large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Green Angel gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays steady
scenarios.body: Green Angel can dictate throughout and kick clear when the field bunches up behind, exploiting the lack of early pace pressure. The hold-up horses will struggle to make ground through traffic in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracking Success
scenarios.trigger: If Captains Speech and other prominent runners track Green Angel closely
scenarios.body: The trackers can pounce when Green Angel tires, having avoided the traffic chaos further back while staying in touch. Form horses like Captains Speech are perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: Hold-up horses get their chance as the race becomes a sprint finish with less traffic issues. Le Moulin Rouge and other proven stayers can use their stamina to good effect.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Green Angel fades early and no one takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes stop-start with no clear leader, creating chaos and opening the door for an outsider. Traffic problems multiply as horses bunch up with no clear pace anchor.

watchPoints.text: Green Angel must be watched for early pace - if he fails to lead or gets headed early, the entire race dynamic collapses
Traffic problems in the straight will be severe with 17 runners - hold-up horses like Le Moulin Rouge and The Rebel Fox need clear runs
Captains Speech is the form pick but needs to position prominently early to avoid the inevitable traffic chaos behind Green Angel
Several reserves including Sir Topham Hatt and Tinto De Verano could cause tactical disruption if they gain entry late
Multiple horses returning from long breaks including Le Moulin Rouge (103d) and Imarajan (398d) may need the run

races.paceDynamic: Ceroc and Hitthehayson are the confirmed front runners who will contest the early pace in this competitive handicap hurdle. Both have leading tendencies and will likely set an honest gallop over the extended trip, with Noble Talent potentially tracking them prominently. The sustained pace over 2m4f on good ground will test stamina reserves in the closing stages, creating opportunities for those who can stay and finish. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the early pace battle will set up the race for closers with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong between Ceroc and Hitthehayson
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will drain the leaders' reserves, allowing patient hold-up performers to strike late with superior finishing kicks. Horses like Teenage Kiss, Sean Mc, and Great Bird are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Noble Talent or Accustomed can track the pace without overexerting
scenarios.body: One of the prominent racers can get first run on the tiring leaders while holding off the late challengers. Their tactical position gives them the jump on both the faltering pace-setters and the hold-up horses still making ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Hitthehayson's class tells and he can dominate throughout
scenarios.body: The lower-weighted front runner can exploit his chase-winning form to wire the field, using his 5lb claim effectively. His back-to-back chase victories suggest the stamina to sustain pressure over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Closer Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final furlong
scenarios.body: An unfancied hold-up horse from the rear can time their run perfectly when the principals falter. This scenario suits the longest-priced closers who need maximum pace assistance to be competitive.

watchPoints.text: Ceroc and Hitthehayson must avoid getting into a speed duel that compromises both chances
Teenage Kiss needs cover in the early stages to preserve his finishing kick for maximum impact
Noble Talent's early position with Anna McGuinness will indicate if they're going for home or playing waiting game
Jack Kennedy's tactics on Accustomed will reveal whether he rates the horse's chance highly
Any market moves for Annie's Belle or Ersudaly on handicap debuts could signal stable confidence

races.paceDynamic: Walks The Talk will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable tempo without pressure in this small field. Long Branch, Agameoftwohalves, and Rocky's Howya will track in behind as prominent racers, with only Jisco Du Brem held up. The lack of pace pressure means the leaders can dictate terms and kick when they choose. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and prominent racers who can travel well and have something left for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Walks The Talk gets an easy lead and kicks clear from two out

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: Gordon Elliott's charge gets the step up in distance he may need and Jack Kennedy's tactical nous comes into play. The combination could time their run perfectly as the others tie up in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Jisco Du Brem finds significant improvement off his low weight
scenarios.body: Danny Mullins gets a dream setup with the pace up front and the 14lb weight advantage tells in the closing stages. The return to better ground suits this bumper winner who has been struggling over hurdles.

races.paceDynamic: Harty Cup will lead unopposed from the start with no other confirmed front runners in this field. Five horses want prominent positions (Choccabloc, Cloonainra, Tequila Talkin', The Great Nudie, Mahon's Way) creating congestion behind the leader and potential traffic problems turning for home. The hold-up horses (Ho My Lord, Duffys Hodey, Park Of Kings, Three In A Row) will be dependent on the pace collapsing or finding racing room late. This honest gallop with prominent congestion clearly favours horses that can either lead from the front or sit prominently with room to manoeuvre.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Harty Cup maintains a steady tempo without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The young horse can dictate throughout and kick clear when the prominent group starts scrapping behind him. This scenario heavily favours the leader and any horse that can track him closely without getting caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Scrap
scenarios.trigger: If the five prominent runners engage in a pace battle behind Harty Cup
scenarios.body: The congestion creates a stop-start rhythm that suits horses with tactical speed who can pick their way through or those held up with a clear run. Late runners get their chance as the pace collapses.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Leader Pressure
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners decide to challenge Harty Cup from early
scenarios.body: The increased gallop stretches the field and creates a true test of stamina over this extended trip. Horses with proven staying power and class ratings get their opportunity.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of early pace leads to a sprint finish from the last fence
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of speed rather than stamina with horses getting long runs from off the pace. Those with the highest recent speed figures and tactical pace benefit most.

watchPoints.text: Harty Cup could get an uncontested lead if the prominent runners sit too far back early and dictate the race completely
Traffic problems likely at the second last fence when Choccabloc, Cloonainra, The Great Nudie and Mahon's Way converge behind the leader
Three In A Row needs the pace to collapse or clear running room given his hold-up style in a race lacking genuine early pace

races.paceDynamic: Supreme Jet will lead this field and set a sustainable pace without pressure, as he's the only confirmed front-runner in the 17-runner field. The real danger lies behind him where Fakir d'Oudairies, Flash De Touzaine, Dont Go Yet, Farmers Lodge, Krabat, Caesar Rock and Brideswell Lad all want prominent positions, creating significant traffic problems turning for home. With so many hold-up horses like Bythesametoken, The Folkes Tiara, Watch The Weather, A Wave Of The Sea, The Banger Doyle, Union Park, Fighting Fit and Digby needing room, the pace will compress dangerously 2-3 out. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can secure good positions early and avoid the inevitable scrimmaging behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Position Premium
scenarios.trigger: If the early prominent group secures clean jumping positions without interference
scenarios.body: Supreme Jet's honest gallop sets up perfectly for the prominent runners who avoid traffic, with the hold-up brigade struggling to find gaps when it matters. The likes of Fakir d'Oudairies and Flash De Touzaine can utilize their class from forward positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or the prominent group goes too hard early
scenarios.body: Supreme Jet's pace proves too generous and the hold-up horses get the perfect setup, with Bythesametoken and The Folkes Tiara timing late runs to perfection. The De Bromhead and O'Sullivan expertise in handicaps pays dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Carnage Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses get hampered or brought down in the home straight melee
scenarios.body: The congested field creates chaos turning for home with several fallers or badly hampered runners, allowing an outsider to inherit victory. One of the better-weighted runners like Dont Go Yet or Caesar Rock capitalizes on others' misfortune.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Supreme Jet gets an easy lead and the field fails to close him down
scenarios.body: Supreme Jet utilizes his front-running style to maximum effect, dictating terms throughout and holding off all challengers in the straight. His recent consistent efforts in beginners' chases prove decisive against this handicap field.

runners_data.comment: Clear of third-placed Butty O'Brien in C&D win last month; big chance of follow-up win
runners_data.spotlight: Winning pointer with placed hurdles form and off the mark chasing at the second attempt in C&D handicap last month in first-time blinkers, showing good attitude to shrug off a strong favourite (pair clear of third-placed Butty O'Brien); 7lb rise looks fine, big chance of a follow-up win if handling quicker conditions.

runners_data.name: Rajjnatin
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades in finishes, more encouraging yard debut suggests improvement possible
runners_data.comment: Down Royal hurdle third to Rockstown Girl on yard debut; same terms switched to fences now
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in maidens and handicaps for Evanna McCutcheon, more encouraging yard debut in 2m5f Down Royal handicap hurdle last month when well backed, finishing third to Rockstown Girl; meets that rival on same terms here on chase debut.

races.paceDynamic: Butty O Brien is the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner handicap chase, giving him a soft lead without early pressure. The prominent runners like Finnians Row, Person Of Interest and Baltinglass Hill will track behind but won't challenge the pace early. With most of the field holding up including dangerous types like Rockstown Girl, Nolans Rocco and My Good Pal, this sets up as a waiting race where the tempo will be steady until the business end. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as they'll get the perfect pace scenario to unleash finishing speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady throughout with Butty O Brien unchallenged early
scenarios.body: The patient riders get the perfect setup to wind up their mounts from the back, with plenty of horse left for the climb to the line. Late-running types with proven stamina will sweep past the early leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners like Finnians Row decides to pressure Butty O Brien earlier than expected
scenarios.body: This creates a more honest pace that suits horses who can travel strongly in the first half of the field without needing to come from too far back. The pure hold-up horses may find too much to do.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Butty O Brien gets such an easy time that he can quicken off the front turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace means he has enough left to resist the late challengers, especially if some hold-up horses get caught in traffic. His experience and tactical advantage proves decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Helps Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes significant interference or several fancied horses make jumping errors
scenarios.body: A horse that travels smoothly and jumps cleanly can benefit from others' misfortune, with the race falling apart in front of them. This suits honest types who may lack the class but have the stamina.

watchPoints.text: Butty O Brien must be allowed an uncontested lead early - if prominent runners pressure him the whole race dynamic changes
Traffic problems likely with 19 runners turning for home - hold-up horses like Rockstown Girl and My Good Pal need clear runs
Several horses carry headgear changes including Person Of Interest's new visor and Butty O Brien's first-time cheekpieces
Multiple horses have completion issues including Warm In Gorey who has fallen/pulled up in last three starts
Amateur riders on My Good Pal and several claiming jockeys take valuable weight off their mounts in this competitive handicap
